resources.string: The front camera is in use. Tap Stop to end tracking.
Lets Hand Navigation PRO draw a pointer and perform taps, drags, scrolls and Back when you use hand gestures. It does not read your screen content.
Control the tablet with your hand using the front camera. Camera processing only runs while navigation is started, and a camera notification is always shown. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

Required: you must enable the Accessibility Service yourself. Tap \"Open Accessibility Settings\", find Hand Navigation PRO (maybe under Installed apps / Downloaded apps), and switch it on. On Android 13+ you may first need App info -> three dots menu -> Allow restricted settings.

GESTURES

 Index finger: move the pointer. Move your hand, the pointer follows your index fingertip.

 Pinch (thumb + index tip touch, then release): tap. Pinch stays on target even while your fingers close.

 Pinch and hold, then move: drag and drop. Holding a pinch without moving for half a second acts as a long-press.

 Index + middle fingers up (ring and pinky folded): scroll. Move your hand up or down while holding this pose.

 Closed fist (hold for about a third of a second): Back.

 Open palm, all five fingers spread (hold for about 0.7 seconds): pause or resume tracking. Paused tracking only reacts to the open palm.
